title.value: Multi-Head Adapter Routing for Cross-Task Generalization
title.justification: The title is directly extracted from the paper.
title.quote: Multi-Head Adapter Routing for Cross-Task Generalization

extractions.description: This paper investigates parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) for cross-task generalization by advancing a method called Multi-Head Routing (MHR). MHR improves adapter routing by providing more granular parameter combinations via Multi-Head Routing, leading to enhanced few-shot adaptation performance.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is enhancing deep learning models' efficiency in adapting to new tasks, specifically through better routing functions in parameter-efficient fine-tuning, without a specific focus on climate or ecological sustainability.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this paper, we investigate the role that adapter routing plays in its success and design new variants based on our findings.
